svg.title: On the bench: Agent Harness (in progress) and a self-hosted home DNS server
svg.desc: Personal projects sheet. Left, Agent Harness, marked in progress: a long-running task moves through goal, plan, act, verify and save stations; a failed verify loops back to act for a retry, and every step reads from and writes to a long-term memory drum, which guards against hallucinations. Right, a home DNS server: phones, a TV and a PC send DNS queries on port 53 to an old Ubuntu laptop running Technitium DNS Server, which resolves them for the whole home network and forwards the rest upstream to the internet.
